Riegert, Auditor-Treasurer P.O. Box 266 16 3rd Avenue East Ada, MN 56510 Phone: (218)784-5471 Fax: (218) 784-4531 Auditor@normanmn.gov Office Hours 8:30 - 4:30 p.m. Monday through Friday Closed on Observed Holidays The Auditor/Treasurer’s Office is part of the administrative branch of County government and interacts with county departments, county residents, the vendors, local governments, state and federal agencies, school districts, and special districts. The County Auditor/Treasurer is the Property Tax Administrator and Supervisor of Elections. The Auditor/Treasurer is also a member, by statute, of the county board of equalization, the county canvassing committee, and sits on various other committees, councils, and boards, as directed by the board. Some of the functions of this department include: Aggregate Tax Cash Management County Beaver Control County Budgets, Payroll and Annual Financial Statement County Drainage Ditches County Liquor/Tobacco/Auctioneer License Passports Property Taxes Property Conveyances Voter Registration & Elections Aggregate Tax All Operators who transport aggregate are responsible for the Aggregate Removal Tax. Click here for more information. Minnesota Statute 298.75 Aggregate Material Removal; Production Tax Cash Management Invests all surplus county funds. Maintains and monitors the county's investment portfolio and all county bank accounts. Reconciles monthly statements. Affidavit for Duplicate of Lost or Destroyed Warrant County Beaver Control County Beaver Control Policy - 2017 Trapper Registration Form County Beaver & Gopher Control Claim Forms Please choose which claim form you need and fill it out. Forms are available at the bottom of this page. If you choose the beaver control claim form, please have your district’s county commissioners sign it before you bring it to our office. If you choose the gopher control claim form, please return it to one of your township officials. Beaver Control Claim Form (your district county commissioner signature required) Gopher Control Claim Form (your township official signature required) County Budgets, Payroll and Annual Financial Statement Issues payment for County department obligations, collects all county revenues, prepares monthly reports and the annual financial statement. Compiles and publishes the annual budget. County Drainage Ditches Administers the county drainage system. Files special assessments against benefited landowners for the purpose of funding repairs and maintenance costs. Ditch Petition Form County Liquor/Tobacco Licenses & Auctioneer License Issues County Liquor Licenses through the Minnesota Liquor Control Commission and issues other miscellaneous licenses. Auctioneer License Application Passports Passport Applications Accepted Passport photos are now available. $20 for each photo. Ages 2 and up. Property Taxes Real Estate and Personal Property Tax Statements and Valuation Notices are mailed once per year, typically late March. In 2026, tax statements and valuation notices will be mailed in the same envelope . If you purchased or sold property after January 1 st this year the tax statement will be mailed to the previous owner. Statements are not automatically resent due to a transfer in ownership or taxpayer responsibility. Duplicate statements will be available on our website after they are certified. Calculates rates and prepares tax information, tax statements and "Truth in Taxation" notices. Bills for and collects all property taxes and county special assessments. Keeps records of all taxing district levies (towns, cities, schools, etc.), tax collections and unpaid taxes. Places delinquent property tax parcels into judgment, administers forfeiture proceedings and sales, and uses revenue recapture as a collection method, according to statute. Monitors tax increment finance compliance. Norman County Property Taxes are now available online . Mobile Home Tax Information First half mobile home tax payment is due August 31; second half payment is due November 15. Taxes of $100 or less are due in full on August 31. If you plan to move your mobile home you need a Mobile Home Statement. It states that all delinquent and current taxes are paid in full. Any taxes not paid will need to be paid before the mobile home can be moved. Direct Payment Program: We have implemented an automated payment program for taxes that allows us to withdraw funds on the due date directly from your checking or savings account as authorized by you. It's quick, easy and eliminates the worry of not making your payment on time. If you are interested in signing up for the program print off the Authorization Form linked to this article and return it by April 15 for the first half taxes payable May 15 or by September 15 for the second half taxes payable October 15 or November 15. Note: It's against the law to write a bad check in Minnesota. Checks returned to us for nonpayment are subject to a service charge of $30.00. Additional civil penalty may be imposed on checks returned for nonpayment after 30 days. MN Statute 604.113 Payments received will be applied first to any outstanding penalty, interest or fee associated with the parcel before applying to property tax. Property Conveyances Collects all mortgage registration, state deed taxes and split fees. Processes all documents transferring property titles and entering them in a permanent database before they are filed with the County Recorder. Voter Registration & Elections Voter Registration and Elections . Enters and maintains all County voter's registrations on the state system. Administers election process including training election judges, city, town, and school district officials. Tallies and reports election night returns. Links to the Minnesota Office of the Secretary of State: Register to Vote Voter Registration Application Voter Information Absentee Ballot Applications are located at the bottom of this page. To obtain an absentee ballot through the mail, complete the Absentee Ballot Application, (link below) and send it to the Norman County Auditor at PO Box 266, Ada, MN 56510 or fax to 218-784-4531. Your ballot will be sent to you when it is ready (as early as 30 days before Election Day). Ballot Drop Box Locations Election results and training information are available at the Minnesota Secretary of State web site.
